verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Warehouse Sync and its API. It ingests user data in bulk from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks, with SQL-based data mapping, so the product does handle many records at once. Nothing shows general bulk actions such as batch update, delete or edit across many items (users, audiences, events) from an API or an AI-driven workflow. The other docs are title-only and say nothing about batching. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints for update and delete operations, bulk actions on audiences or profiles, AI- or agent-driven bulk workflows, limits and throughput documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
